# XY Forever serial protocol 1.34: commands

Part of the [XY Forever serial protocol 1.34](../PROTOCOL.md).

## Commands

| Type | Name | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 0x01 | [`hello`](cmd-session.md#0x01-hello) | greet the device; required before any other command |
| 0x03 | [`file.read`](cmd-session.md#0x03-fileread) | read a file, whole (at most 4096 bytes) or a range |
| 0x04 | [`screen.read`](cmd-session.md#0x04-screenread) | read part of the display framebuffer (screenshot) |
| 0x10 | [`stage.begin`](cmd-stage.md#0x10-stagebegin) | announce an image to stage in RAM |
| 0x11 | [`stage.data`](cmd-stage.md#0x11-stagedata) | send the next piece of the staged image |
| 0x12 | [`stage.end`](cmd-stage.md#0x12-stageend) | check the staged image against its CRC-32 and SHA-256 |
| 0x13 | [`file.write_staged`](cmd-stage.md#0x13-filewrite_staged) | write the staged image to a file under /yaffs2/ (the write area) |
| 0x14 | [`file.list`](cmd-files.md#0x14-filelist) | list one folder, a page at a time |
| 0x15 | [`file.delete`](cmd-files.md#0x15-filedelete) | delete one file |
| 0x16 | [`file.rmdir`](cmd-files.md#0x16-filermdir) | remove one empty folder |
| 0x17 | [`file.mkdir`](cmd-files.md#0x17-filemkdir) | create one folder |
| 0x18 | [`file.rename`](cmd-file-move.md#0x18-filerename) | rename or move one file or folder |
| 0x19 | [`file.copy`](cmd-file-move.md#0x19-filecopy) | copy one file on the device |
| 0x1a | [`file.write_begin`](cmd-file-stream.md#0x1a-filewrite_begin) | start a streamed, replace-safe write of one file |
| 0x1b | [`file.write_data`](cmd-file-stream.md#0x1b-filewrite_data) | send the next piece of a streamed write |
| 0x1c | [`file.write_end`](cmd-file-stream.md#0x1c-filewrite_end) | check the streamed file and rename it onto its target |
| 0x1d | [`file.hash`](cmd-file-stream.md#0x1d-filehash) | hash a stored file on the device: its size and SHA-256 |
| 0x1e | [`file.read_stream`](cmd-file-stream.md#0x1e-fileread_stream) | read the next piece of a file, kept open between pieces |
| 0x20 | [`boot.install`](cmd-boot-write.md#0x20-bootinstall) | install the staged XY Forever build into the boot partition |
| 0x21 | [`boot.uninstall`](cmd-boot-write.md#0x21-bootuninstall) | put the stock 1.2.1 os.ldr back into the boot partition |
| 0x22 | [`boot.uninstall_start`](cmd-boot-write.md#0x22-bootuninstall_start) | start the device's stock restoration and restart |
| 0x30 | [`device.reboot`](cmd-boot.md#0x30-devicereboot) | restart both processors |
| 0x31 | [`menu.continue`](cmd-boot.md#0x31-menucontinue) | leave the menu and boot the default firmware |
| 0x32 | [`service.hold`](cmd-boot.md#0x32-servicehold) | keep the device in the menu across restarts |
| 0x35 | [`menu.converge`](cmd-boot.md#0x35-menuconverge) | converge, then boot: the saved inputs, or one library entry once; and the sequence's state |
| 0x40 | [`library.set_default`](cmd-library.md#0x40-libraryset_default) | make a library entry the default firmware |
| 0x41 | [`tfw.check`](cmd-library.md#0x41-tfwcheck) | check that a firmware package on the device is official and that the device's own keys open it |
| 0x43 | [`library.boot`](cmd-library.md#0x43-libraryboot) | boot a library entry once, as PLAY on it in the library menu |
| 0x44 | [`mods.apply`](cmd-jobs.md#0x44-modsapply) | start assembling mod firmware on the device (a job) |
| 0x45 | [`job.status`](cmd-jobs.md#0x45-jobstatus) | progress of the running or last job |
| 0x46 | [`job.cancel`](cmd-jobs.md#0x46-jobcancel) | stop the running job |
| 0x47 | [`package.session`](cmd-jobs.md#0x47-packagesession) | exclude other storage jobs during a host package transaction |
| 0x48 | [`tfw.check_role`](cmd-firmware.md#0x48-tfwcheck_role) | check an official firmware cut with the selected processor’s own OTP keys |
| 0x49 | [`package.list`](cmd-storage.md#0x49-packagelist) | list packages and their exact identity |
| 0x4a | [`state.get`](cmd-storage.md#0x4a-stateget) | read boot slots, content record and durable job intent |
| 0x4b | [`storage.space`](cmd-storage.md#0x4b-storagespace) | report free storage bytes |
| 0x4c | [`dev.a_rehearsal`](cmd-storage.md#0x4c-deva_rehearsal) | transfer staged B input to A and admit it without writing |
| 0x4d | [`config.get`](cmd-config.md#0x4d-configget) | read the saved inputs: mod selection, safe mode, Mod memory |
| 0x4e | [`config.set`](cmd-config.md#0x4e-configset) | save the mod selection, safe mode and Mod memory (built at the next boot) |
| 0x4f | [`packs.manage`](cmd-config.md#0x4f-packsmanage) | import or toggle a .tfw sound pack and inspect progress |

A typical session: `hello`; then reads (`file.read`, `screen.read`); to write, `stage.begin`, `stage.data` in order, `stage.end`, then one of
`file.write_staged`, `boot.install`, `boot.uninstall`.
